notes.page_account: The page continues a claim that a homotopy type can be recovered through its fundamental infinity-groupoid, with all cohomological operations included in the system of n-categories. It then proposes a parallel expectation for more elaborated homotopy types associated with finite diagrams and stratifications of moderated spaces: (n+1)-categories of n-champs constant on strata, and a recovery through a subcategory of the derived category of abelian sheaves together with derived tensor and Hom. This is an account of what the page says, not verification of the claims.
